design.change: Runway-specific taxi measurement covariance, partially pooled with original global matrix
design.retained: Original Huber bias, sqrt(count) normalization, three-MAD covariance filter, t5 likelihood, diagonal floor
design.shrinkage: Selected runway training cell count divided by itself plus100; unseen/under3cell runway uses global
design.validation: Leave one calendar month out inside each allowed outer training window; drop new boundary days
design.score: Mean per-month held source negative t5 log likelihood; all held source cells including untrimmed tails
design.gate: Both outer windows improve and each paired whole-day95% interval upper endpoint below0
design.continuation: Only a passing fixed source screen permits challenge Jan/Jul evaluation
design.failure: Close; do not tune shrinkage or trim thresholds
design.caveat: Source calibration validation is not taxi prediction validation; outer training windows may overlap
